about_the_game:
MASTER THE PLATFORMS, MASTER THE MATH




Timing and mathematics go hand in hand. Leap and dash across platforms, but be vigilant - only the right platform, marked with the correct answer to a multiplication challenge, will keep you from plunging into the depths. Quick thinking and swift moves are your keys to survival.

UNLOCK THE POWER OF ANIMAL SPIRITS




As you conquer each set of multiplication tables, from 1x to 12x, you'll release the spirits of animals held captive. These grateful creatures bestow powerful buffs, aiding you in your mathematical quest. Harness their strengths to make your journey easier and more fun.

A WORLD OF NUMBERS AWAITS




Multiplication Mastery: Navigate through each multiplication table from 1x to 12x, tackling levels that present numbers in sequence and others that mix them up for added challenge.
Square Number Special: Take on a unique level dedicated to square numbers - a treat for math enthusiasts!
Marathon Mode: For the bravest of players, test your endurance and skill in Marathon Mode. Here, you'll face a relentless stream of multiplications from all the tables. How long can you last?

DIVE INTO THE EPIC STORY




Progress the voiced visual novel style story and make it your unique story.

In the mystical skies of Aetheria, math and myth intertwine in an epic tale of balance and harmony. "Multiplication Mayhem" invites players to step into the shoes of a young Earth student, destined to free the spirit animals and restore peace to a realm in turmoil. Overcome challenges, unlock ancient mysteries, and prepare for a showdown with the corrupted guardian, Lord of Storms, in this story-driven adventure!

Key Features:


  • Custom Avatars: Choose a hero in your image.
  • Progressive Difficulty: Journey through levels that grow with your skill, perfect for mastering multiplication tables with ease.
  • Unique Power-ups: Rescue spirit animals and wield their magical abilities to aid you in your quest.
  • Vibrant Worlds: Explore floating islands, each with its own secrets and challenges.
  • Interactive Learning: Engage in gameplay designed for real-world application, where quick thinking and strategy lead to success.

A Message from the Developer:

Inspired by a daughter's struggle with multiplication tables, "Multiplication Mayhem" is born out of a passion to make learning engaging and thrilling. Our game is meticulously crafted to blend educational content with exhilarating gameplay for an unforgettable learning experience.

Development Journey:

Our path to creating "Multiplication Mayhem" was a labour of love, marked by challenges and triumphs. From achieving the perfect fusion of gameplay and education to creating an art style as vibrant as Aetheria itself, our journey has been one of passion and dedication.

Wishlist now to embark on your Mathematical odyssey this Autumn and transform the way you learn multiplication forever!
